feature_definitions.liquidation_shock: current bar return <= threshold with elevated volume ratio; current and past bars only
feature_definitions.recent_shock_window: rolling window over past closed bars using shift(1)
feature_definitions.recovery_confirmation: current bar has positive close-to-close return after a recent shock and is not itself a shock

no_lookahead.feature_basis: current/past OHLCV; recent shock uses shifted historical shock flags
